long_biography.plain_text:
MW Afritec placed Marc Piedbœuf in the operating core of one of Congo's infrastructure businesses. The company worked across civil engineering and road and maritime freight, giving his partnership with Alain Wan a base beyond a single sector. Their interests also encompassed Carrières du Congo and board participation in other local companies.

Agriculture became another substantial part of Piedbœuf's record through Grands Élevages du Bas-Congo and the management of large farming operations. In Kinshasa, he has additionally coordinated Homo Centrum and directed Initiative Écologique et Biodiversité pour le Congo. The latter appears in the Democratic Republic of Congo's official register of associations and nongovernmental organizations.

uncertainties: The official government listing gives the full form Henri Jean Marc Piedbœuf, but the owner record treats Marc as the first name. Henri Jean is therefore not proposed as middle_names because the ordering and exact website-field treatment require human confirmation.

The historic Brasserie Piedbœuf and its merger into Interbrew are well documented, but no reliable source found in this pass links this Marc Piedbœuf to the brewery's founding family, inherited shares or an AB InBev stake. The surname alone cannot establish inheritance.

Construction & Engineering is the strongest wealth-creation classification because MW Afritec is the most consistently documented owned operating platform. Agriculture was also material, so confidence remains high rather than very high.

Current primary industry is Unknown because the latest official roles are environmental and nonprofit or establishment-based, while current ownership of the earlier construction and agricultural assets is unclear.
Wealth origin is Unknown because the sources do not establish whether his capital was self-created, inherited, family-transferred or otherwise acquired.
Operator is used rather than Founder because sources clearly document management and co-ownership, but do not reliably establish that Piedbœuf created the original MW Afritec platform.
The official listing supplies organizational locations in Kinshasa, not a confirmed personal residence, so main_residence_country remains unresolved.
No exact Forbes, LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website or other social profile met the verification threshold.
